title: epipactis atrorubens subsp. danubialis
intro: Epipactis atrorubens subsp. danubialis, commonly known as the Dark-red Helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe, particularly in the Danube region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis atrorubens subsp. danubialis include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting potential antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
